# Taplino

> Taplino is a Swiss company selling premium, fully customisable NFC cards for
> businesses. A customer taps their phone on the card (no app, no scanning) and
> instantly opens whatever the business chooses: Google reviews, a digital menu,
> a link hub, socials, WiFi or booking. Cards are personalised, encoded and
> quality-checked in Switzerland and ship in 3-5 days.

Website: https://taplino.ch
Contact: hello@taplino.ch
Languages: German (de), French (fr), Italian (it), English (en)
Compliance: Swiss nFADP (revDSG) and EU GDPR compliant. No data selling, no hidden tracking.
Compatibility: iPhone XR (2018) and newer, and all NFC-enabled Android phones. Every card includes a printed QR code as a fallback.

## What Taplino does

- Turns one tap into more Google reviews, a live multilingual menu, or an all-in-one link hub.
- No app required for the business or its customers. The destination opens in the phone browser.
- Destinations are re-pointable from a dashboard (Pro/Managed plans) without reordering cards.
- Built for restaurants, cafés, shops, salons, fitness studios and any local venue.

## Products (prices in CHF)

- NFC Business Card: from CHF 89, anodised aluminium. Shares contact details, socials and links with one tap, customised to your brand.
- Menu Card: from CHF 39, recycled PVC. Opens a live digital menu in any language; update prices/specials from your phone, never reprint.
- Link Card: from CHF 29, matte PVC. One tap to a link hub with Instagram, WiFi, booking and webshop.
- Google Review Card: from CHF 50, recycled PVC. Credit-card sized; one tap opens your Google review form.

## Pricing plans

- Starter: CHF 50 one-time per card. Buy cards, manage them yourself; one destination per card, free backup QR, email support.
- Pro: CHF 39/month. Unlimited destination changes, analytics & review insights, multiple locations, priority support.
- Managed: CHF 250/month. We run your menu and reviews: 10 personalised cards, menu translation & updates, replies to every Google review, dedicated account manager.

## Use cases

- Google Reviews: a direct link to your review form (no searching) with smart routing to catch feedback before it goes public. Restaurants report roughly 3-5x more reviews in the first month.
- Digital Menu: update prices or add a special from your phone; it goes live instantly on every card. Multilingual (EN/DE/FR/IT), with allergens, photos and daily specials.
- Link Hub: Instagram, TikTok, newsletter sign-up, one-tap WiFi connect, table booking, loyalty and shop links.

## Key facts

- Swiss company; cards designed, encoded and quality-checked in Switzerland.
- Waterproof and durable, built for daily use in busy venues.
- Free shipping in Switzerland, delivery in 3-5 days.
- Live dashboard to track taps, reviews and menu views.
